positions.title: Embedded Engineer
positions.description: Collaborate with experienced development teams to work on projects that advance products. Participates in the formation of projects goals, scope and schedule. Conducts investigative analysis, testing, and develops solutions to routine and non-routine problems. Displays a positive, proactive approach to problem solving. Ability to apply general to complex engineering concepts to support department or company projects. Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing. Thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys working as part of a team. Strong sense of task ownership, urgency and drive.

positions.title: Peer Educator
positions.description: Supporting freshmen and sophomores on computer science courses. Teaching Data Structure and computing courses' materials.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Teacher assistant for Logic Design classes from the Computer Science department. The work consisted of grading course material, tutoring, leading disscussion and laboratory experience, student mentoring, etc.

skills.name: Unit Testing, Linux containers, C++, ALM, Agile/Scrum
